issues.on_page: Inheritance Tax Fund: Intergovernmental 631,922 (budgeted as Taxes 538,179)
issues.issue: Recorded as printed, which the rules require: a fund name does not turn a non-tax line into a tax. But these are almost certainly inheritance tax receipts that the report printed as Intergovernmental. The 631,922 is also inside statement Intergovernmental 3,608,499 (receipts[4], p4). The user may want to settle this.
